chest_pain.title: Chest pain or breathlessness when active
chest_pain.body: Please see a doctor soon, before starting any new exercise. If you have chest pain right now, call **112**.

ed_cardio.title: Erection problems with diabetes, blood pressure or heart disease
ed_cardio.body: Erection problems can be an early sign of heart and blood-vessel disease. Please mention them to your doctor. A check-up can protect your heart as well as your sex life.

ed_recent.title: Sudden or recent erection problems
ed_recent.body: A recent change is worth a check-up with a doctor, a urologist or an andrologist. They can look for causes such as blood-vessel problems, hormones or medicines.

pain_blood.title: Pain, blood, a painful bend or a lump
pain_blood.body: Please see a doctor or urologist. These need a proper examination.

pelvic_pain.title: Pelvic pain or urinary problems
pelvic_pain.body: Stop pelvic-floor exercises if they hurt, and see a doctor or a pelvic-floor physiotherapist. The trainer will use its gentle, relaxation-first version for you.

lifelong_pe.title: Lifelong early ejaculation that bothers you
lifelong_pe.body: In European urology guidelines, medical treatment is the first-line option for lifelong early ejaculation. A doctor can talk you through it, and the techniques in this app work well alongside.

low_desire.title: Low desire with tiredness or low mood
low_desire.body: This can come from hormones, sleep problems, medicines or depression. A doctor can check, often with a simple blood test.

medicines.title: Medicines and side effects
medicines.body: Some medicines can affect erections, ejaculation or desire. Never stop a medicine on your own. Ask your doctor whether there are alternatives.

mental_health.title: Anxiety, low mood or relationship stress
mental_health.body: A psychologist, psychiatrist or a qualified sex therapist can help. In India, **Tele-MANAS (14416)** offers free, confidential mental-health support any time.

resources.title: Where to get help in India
resources.body:
- A **urologist or andrologist** for erection, ejaculation and pain problems
- A **qualified sex therapist** for sexual and relationship concerns
- A **psychiatrist or psychologist** for anxiety and low mood
- **Tele-MANAS: 14416** (free, any time)
- **Emergency: 112** (including an erection lasting more than 4 hours)
